title: Towards Certificate-Driven Software Porting: A Self-Improving Agentic Harness for Scientific Program Optimization
title_zh: 迈向证书驱动的软件移植：用于科学程序优化的自改进智能体框架
abstract_en: The upgrade and rewriting of large scientific codebases has traditionally been a major challenge. While evolutionary search with large language models (LLMs) can port and accelerate legacy code, repair feedback in prompts alone does not prevent subsequent candidates from repeating the same errors. We introduce Certificate-Driven Evolutionary Search (CDES), which extends evolutionary search with enforceable restrictions derived from failed candidates, recorded as certificates of assumptions, checker evidence, and justified restrictions. Its control logic enforces these restrictions through rejection, backtracking, and targeted repair while preserving compatible edits. We apply CDES to CPU-to-GPU translation of two particle-simulation functions from the Geant4 toolkit, evaluated with a harness that goes beyond unit tests to combine formal checks, numerical comparisons, physics checks, and GPU safety tests. Generated implementations achieve 13.78x and 23.54x function-level speedups over CPU code, including data conversion and transfers; for one function, GPU throughput exceeds an expert implementation by 14.9%, reaching 16.1% when complementary components are combined. In an ablation over execution settings, certificate feedback increases the fraction of candidates passing required correctness checks from 55% to 90%.
abstract_zh: 大型科学代码库的升级与重写长期以来极具挑战。尽管结合大语言模型（LLM）的进化搜索能够移植并加速遗留代码，但仅在提示词中加入修复反馈，无法阻止后续候选方案重复相同错误。本文提出 Certificate-Driven Evolutionary Search（CDES，证书驱动的进化搜索）：将失败候选方案中的假设、检查器证据及合理约束记录为证书，并转化为可强制执行的限制。CDES 通过拒绝、回溯和定向修复来落实这些限制，同时保留兼容的代码修改。作者将 CDES 应用于 Geant4 工具包中两个粒子模拟函数的 CPU-to-GPU 转换，并采用超越单元测试的评测框架，综合形式化检查、数值比较、物理一致性检查与 GPU 安全测试。生成的实现计入数据转换和传输开销后，相比 CPU 代码分别获得 13.78 倍和 23.54 倍的函数级加速；其中一个函数的 GPU 吞吐量比专家实现高 14.9%，组合互补组件后优势达到 16.1%。执行设置消融实验显示，证书反馈将通过必要正确性检查的候选方案比例从 55% 提升至 90%。
key_points_zh: 提出 Certificate-Driven Evolutionary Search（CDES），将失败候选中的假设、检查证据与合理约束沉淀为可执行证书。
通过候选拒绝、搜索回溯和定向修复避免重复错误，并尽可能保留与证书兼容的有效代码修改。
构建覆盖形式化验证、数值对比、物理一致性和 GPU 安全性的综合评测框架，而非仅依赖单元测试。
在 Geant4 两个粒子模拟函数的 CPU-to-GPU 移植中实现 13.78 倍和 23.54 倍加速，部分结果超过专家实现。
消融实验表明，证书反馈将候选方案的必要正确性检查通过率从 55% 提升至 90%。

llm_assessment.comment: CDES presents a reusable self-improving coding-agent harness that converts verifier evidence into enforceable constraints for evolutionary search and repair.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: CDES提出了可复用的自我改进编程Agent框架，将验证器证据转化为进化搜索与修复中的强制约束。
